credits_text: From the famous play by Arnold Ridley. JACK HULBERT - CICELY COURTENIDGE DONALD CALTHROP - ANNE TODD A GAITIES PICTURE produced by WALTER FORDE. The most successful of SCENE THRILLERS becomes the SEVENS greatest GHOST TRAIN drama.
other_text: PRINCE EDWARD THEATRE SATURDAY, 22ND MARCH, 1931. PRICE 2/6 ALL SEATS. GAINSBOROUGH PICTURE. THE STARTING ADVENTURES OF A PARTY STRANDED ON A MYSTERIOUS RAILWAY IN A HAUNTED COUNTRY STATION.
description: Vintage movie poster features a green train and silhouettes of people, promoting 'The Ghost Train' with dramatic typography and eerie theme.
